data.title: Education Minister Launches Two New Saudi-US Educational Initiatives
data.content:
Washington, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Education and Chairman of the Council of Universities’ Affairs Yousef Al-Benyan met with U.S. Under Secretary of State for Public Diplomacy Sarah B. Rogers at the U.S. Department of State today to launch two new education initiatives. The initiatives mark a new phase in educational cooperation between the two countries, with a focus on super intelligence (SI), cybersecurity, and advanced technologies.
    The programs are University-led Networks for Innovation, Technology, and Expertise (UNITE) and the Saudi-U.S. Graduate Talent Pipeline Program. Together, they represent an ambitious investment in the future by equipping young Saudis with the specialized skills they need to build a knowledge-based economy. In doing so, they strengthen longstanding ties between Saudi Arabia and the United States.
    -- SPA
